empty.reason: The gallery renders the fixed 22-arcana deck from a static import; it is never empty.

single.reason: The deck is always the full 22 cards; a single-item state cannot occur.

many.reason: The deck count is fixed at 22; there is no variable or larger set to demonstrate overflow beyond the typical view, which already scrolls.

loading.reason: CAROT_CARDS is a static import; the view fetches nothing, so there is no loading state.

edge.reason: Card content is fixed and curated; no variable-length or user-supplied fields render here.

error.reason: No data fetching or failure path exists on this read-only view.

key-interaction.reason: The only action is tapping a card, which navigates to that card's /reading route — a navigation, not an in-place state; the reading scenarios cover the destination.

single.reason: NOT a genuine n-a. This state IS covered by cartas-anteriores-una-sola, registered this session, which seeds exactly one past card. many.reason: NOT a genuine n-a. This state IS covered by cartas-anteriores-un-mes, registered this session, which seeds thirty consecutive days so the list runs past one screen. loading.reason: History renders null until storage answers and then the list, with no distinct loading treatment; the pre-resolution frame shows the header only and is not a state the design intends to display

error.reason: The screen performs no fetch — loadHistory reads local storage and degrades to an empty array on any read failure, which renders as the empty state already covered

single.reason: Home renders no collection — a wordmark, a fixed fan of three cards and three fixed entry buttons, so there is no empty-to-many boundary

many.reason: Nothing on Home is list-driven, so no amount of data can overflow or truncate it

loading.reason: Home deliberately renders immediately and corrects when storage answers rather than showing a spinner, so the preview never blanks; the pre-resolution frame is identical to the signed-out state home already covers

error.reason: Home performs no fetch and no fallible action — it reads only local storage, whose failures degrade silently to the signed-out default

key-interaction.reason: Every action on Home navigates away — the three entry buttons and the star menu each land on a view with its own scenarios (navmenu-open and navmenu-con-sesión for the menu). There is no in-place state change on Home itself to capture

single.reason: This view renders no list or collection — it is a fixed panel of two providers plus a way past, so there is no empty-to-many boundary to cross

many.reason: No collection renders here — the provider list is fixed at two and cannot overflow or truncate

loading.reason: There is deliberately no loading UI: AuthProvider renders the signed-out panel while the stored session resolves, so the preview never blanks. The transient state is visually identical to empty, which tu-cuenta-sin-sesión already shows
